semiconductor_relevance: High — OPAL specializes in high-purity quartz products essential for semiconductor manufacturing and photovoltaic applications.
summary: Zhejiang OPAL Quartz Tech Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of high-purity quartz products tailored for semiconductor and photovoltaic industries. The company focuses on R&D and production of quartz materials, ensuring strict quality control and utilizing premium raw materials from reputable suppliers.
capabilities: High-purity quartz for vertical and epitaxial systems

regional_presence.China: OPAL is located in Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, with significant investment in manufacturing and R&D facilities.
